# Jesus Heals a Crippled Woman (Luke 13:12)

## Emotional Focus
When you feel bent over with worries and need Jesus to lift you.

## Key KJV
“Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.” (Luke 13:12)

## Gentle Retelling
A woman had been bent over for eighteen years. Jesus saw her in the synagogue and said, “Woman, you are loosed.” She stood straight and praised God.

## Coloring Prompt
A woman standing tall with arms raised in praise while Jesus looks on kindly.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus sees you and can lift every heavy thing.”
